title: Music Bingo followed by Karaoke night in Boone’s Bar
seo_title: Music Bingo and Karaoke Night at Boone's Bar in Bolivar
description: Music bingo in the loft at Boone's Bar, where the host plays short clips of popular songs and players mark the matching song or artist on their card until someone yells bingo. It is free to play with a chance to win prizes, drink and food specials are offered, and karaoke starts after bingo. It takes place November 14, 2026, Time TBD, at 5260 S Scenic Ave in Bolivar, MO.
address: 5260 Scenic Ave, Bolivar, MO 65613-3142, United States, Bolivar, MO
